channel.description: Fun posts about Listworthy, the free ranking and list app for iPhone.

item.title: How to save Thanksgiving recipes from Pinterest as clean recipe cards
item.description:
🥧 Thanksgiving recipes, minus the life story, in 3 steps:
1. Find a recipe page or Pinterest pin and tap Share. 2. Send it to Listworthy and get just the ingredients and steps. 3. Cooking? Cook mode keeps your screen on. After dinner, tap "I made this" and give it a score.
What's the one dish your table can't skip?
#Listworthy #ThanksgivingRecipes
Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/listworthy/id6752911163?ppid=36eddce0-e99d-46b7-b73b-88ec00af83a9&pt=128166069&ct=fb-app&mt=8

item.title: How to share a ranked list with friends: Send a Copy in Listworthy
item.description:
📲 New in Listworthy: Send a Copy.
Open any list, tap Share, then Send a Copy. Your friend taps the link and gets the whole list in their Listworthy, posters, scores, tiers and notes included.
Now you can finally prove your top 10 is better than theirs.
Who's getting your list first?
#Listworthy
Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/listworthy/id6752911163?ppid=36eddce0-e99d-46b7-b73b-88ec00af83a9&pt=128166069&ct=fb-app&mt=8

item.title: How to make a holiday gift list with a budget in 3 steps
item.description:
🎁 Holiday gift list in 3 steps:
1. Tap + on the Lists tab and filter by Gifts. 2. Found something in Amazon or another store app? Tap Share and send it to your list. 3. Set a budget, note who gets what, and check off gifts as you buy them.
Who's the hardest person on your list to shop for?
#Listworthy #GiftIdeas
Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/listworthy/id6752911163?ppid=36eddce0-e99d-46b7-b73b-88ec00af83a9&pt=128166069&ct=fb-app&mt=8

item.title: Thanksgiving Movies is live in Quick Rank
item.description:
🦃 New in Quick Rank: Thanksgiving Movies.

Which one do you watch every single year?
